Maybe the intended approach: Use proton_nmr_spectra tool without specifying SMILES? The tool signature takes no arguments. It returns spectra for a given SMILES? But no SMILES param. That's odd. The tool definition: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No input. So maybe the system has a default compound loaded? Could be that the environment has a current sample. So calling proton_nmr_spectra will give the NMR of the compound in question. Then we can count distinct peaks (unique chemical shifts) to infer number of unique hydrogen environments.

Thus we should call proton_nmr_spectra.
